g.text: Non-destructive Assessment of Citrus Fruit Quality
From Orchard Sampling to Predictive Phenotyping
Schematic; no instrument model, wavelength or performance claim
Canopy fruit at three maturity stages
Destructive assays on representative sub-samples calibrate and validate the model
fitted on paired spectra and reference assays
Predicted per fruit; no numeric claims
validation error returns to the model
